# `memorized-report` commands

## `memorized-report create`

Memorize a report: keep a report and its options under a name, optionally in a group, for everyone in the company, as the anchor's Memorize button does. filters are the report's own inputs, checked against it now. date_range keeps a named range -- this_month, last_fiscal_year, this_fiscal_year_to_date, ... -- that is resolved again at every run, so a report memorized as This Month shows June in June and December in December; without it, the dates in filters are kept as given.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | reports |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/memorized-report.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow memorized-report create --name "Budget this quarter" --report budget-vs-actual --filters '{"budget": "Plan 2026"}' --date-range this_fiscal_quarter --group Company --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Monthly review" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "memorized-report create", "input": {"name": "Budget this quarter", "report": "budget-vs-actual", "filters": {"budget": "Plan 2026"}, "date_range": "this_fiscal_quarter", "group": "Company"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `--name` | string | yes | no | — | Name to keep the report under; unique within the company, ignoring case.; minimum length 1; maximum length 200 |
| `report` | `--report` | string | yes | no | — | The report, by its name: profit-and-loss, budget-vs-actual, ar-aging, ... (`bookflow report --help` lists them).; minimum length 1; maximum length 64 |
| `filters` | `--filters` | object[string, any] | no | no | {} | The report's own inputs, exactly as `report <name>` takes them; cursor and limit are not kept. |
| `date_range` | `--date-range` | literal["today", "this_week", "this_week_to_date", "this_month", "this_month_to_date", "this_fiscal_quarter", "this_fiscal_quarter_to_date", "this_fiscal_year", "this_fiscal_year_to_date", "yesterday", "last_week", "last_month", "last_month_to_date", "last_fiscal_quarter", "last_fiscal_year", "last_fiscal_year_to_date", "this_calendar_year", "last_calendar_year", "next_month", "next_fiscal_quarter", "next_fiscal_year"] \| null | no | yes | null | A named date range resolved again at every run, in the company's timezone and fiscal year: this_month, last_fiscal_year, this_fiscal_year_to_date, ... It replaces the dates in filters. Omitted, the dates in filters are kept as they are. |
| `group` | `--group` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Memorized report group to file it under, such as Company or Banking; omitted, no group. |

## `memorized-report run`

Run a memorized report: its named date range resolved to dates for today in the company's timezone and fiscal year, then the report command run with the kept options as the caller, so the caller needs that report's own permission. Returns the inputs it ran with and the report's own output; page with limit and the report's next_cursor.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | reports |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/memorized-report.run` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `memorized_report` | `MEMORIZED_REPORT` | string | yes | no | — | Memorized report id, or its exact name (ignoring case).; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer | no | no | 50 | Rows on the page.; minimum 1; maximum 200 |
| `cursor` | `--cursor` | string \| null | no | yes | null | The report's own next_cursor from the previous page. |

## `memorized-report update`

Rename a memorized report, move it to another group, or replace the report and options it keeps (the anchor's Replace when memorizing again). Fields not given are left alone; --clear group or date_range takes it out of its group or back to fixed dates.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | reports |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/memorized-report.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow memorized-report update "Budget this quarter" --group Accountant --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Refile" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "memorized-report update", "input": {"memorized_report": "Budget this quarter", "group": "Accountant"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `memorized_report` | `MEMORIZED_REPORT` | string | yes | no | — | Memorized report id, or its exact name (ignoring case).; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `name` | `--name` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New name. |
| `group` | `--group` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New group. |
| `report` | `--report` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Replace the report it runs (the anchor's Replace when memorizing again). |
| `filters` | `--filters` | object[string, any] \| null | no | yes | null | Replace the report's inputs. |
| `date_range` | `--date-range` | literal["today", "this_week", "this_week_to_date", "this_month", "this_month_to_date", "this_fiscal_quarter", "this_fiscal_quarter_to_date", "this_fiscal_year", "this_fiscal_year_to_date", "yesterday", "last_week", "last_month", "last_month_to_date", "last_fiscal_quarter", "last_fiscal_year", "last_fiscal_year_to_date", "this_calendar_year", "last_calendar_year", "next_month", "next_fiscal_quarter", "next_fiscal_year"] \| null | no | yes | null | Replace the named date range. |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | Version returned by memorized-report show; a stale update is refused. |

### Command and context options

| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/memorized-report.update`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.
